# GraphStyles

The visual encoding of the force graph, as a spec the PIXI renderer follows: node states, size by connections, fill modes, labels, link types and weights, plus…

`SongNodes.GraphStyles` · Graph

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.GraphStyles colourMode="none" visibleEdgeTypes={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.GraphStyles" colour-mode="none" visible-edge-types="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (GraphStylesProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `colourMode` * | `"none" \| "energy" \| "key" \| "genre"` | Current node colour mode; the legend mirrors it. |
| `genres` | `string[]` | Genres in fixed slot order (max 7 + Other) for the genre legend. |
| `visibleEdgeTypes` * | `GraphEdgeType[]` | Edge types currently drawn (from the layer toggles). |
| `hasPath` | `boolean` | Whether a path is shown, to include path rings in the legend. |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | Collapsed behind a "Legend" button (phones). |
